item.stem:
The diagram shows a number line from $4.0$ to $5.0$ with equal tenth marks. Lalit must place point $Q$ at $4.3$.

Which claim correctly places $Q$?

options.A: $Q$ is the left endpoint $4.0$, so rename the target as that endpoint.
options.B: Marking $Q$ at $4.3$ is what creates the equal tenths between $4.0$ and $5.0$.
options.C: Count $3$ equal tenths from $4.0$ toward $5.0$, and put $Q$ on that mark.
options.D: Put $Q$ at the printed $5.0$, because $5$ is the standout digit near $4.3$.
